headline: Wardens Reclaim Callahan's Passage; Weathered Expanse Seethes On
war_summary: Since our last edition the tide has turned at Callahan's Passage: the Colonial foothold there has vanished, Wardens now flying over nine of ten strongholds and the tenth in ruins, after a day's butchery that cost each army better than ten thousand men. Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage took the worst of it, and the guns there were firing minutes before this edition went to press. In the Weathered Expanse the Wardens have at last planted a flag—five posts Colonial, three demolished—with Wightwalk and Crow's Nest again the storm-centers of forty-five recorded actions; Warden losses run heaviest and the rates are climbing. The Nevish Line, so troubled overnight, has gone quiet since mid-morning, the Colonial bridgehead still fixed at two of eight posts. Palantine Berm's flare at Leiri Hermanni has likewise subsided, the flags unmoved. Stlican Shelf smolders anew at Briar, eight posts to one, its casualty rates accelerating once more. Mooring County keeps its twelve Warden posts while The Wind Hills churns and the casualty ledgers swell. It is day 503; thirty-four victory towns will settle this war, and neither banner yet claims it.
